name: langguard-arbiter
description: LangGuard checks MCP tool calls against your organization's policies.

host.title: Address
host.description: Your organization's own LangGuard address, like https://yourcompany.app.langguard.ai.

api_token.title: API key
api_token.description: Create a key with ingest access in LangGuard: Settings, Arbiter Management, Deploy Arbiter.

enforcement_mode.title: Mode
enforcement_mode.description: cooperative: when LangGuard cannot check a call, it asks you first. strict: when LangGuard cannot check a call, it blocks the call.
